purpose: Scratch-only BuildBuddy CLI observer-loss recovery patch evidence for architecture review.

source.hosted_tree_note: bbr applied the complete local source-tree diff to the hosted base; logs showed the changed paths applied cleanly.

behavior.log_observer_error: After Run returns an accepted invocation, a non-context log stream error does not cancel that run. The CLI waits on the execution associated with that same invocation, then reads fresh invocation metadata after terminal execution.
behavior.unknown_outcome: Fallback or normal-path post-acceptance result-read errors retain their cause, carry errAcceptedRunOutcomeUnknown, and are not retried by the outer Run loop.
behavior.terminal_without_execute_response: A terminal operation without ExecuteResponse remains an error/unknown outcome; it cannot become success or trigger a new Run.
behavior.preserved_behavior: Real nonzero ExecuteResponse exit codes are returned. Explicit caller cancellation/deadline still cancels unfinished accepted work. Successful log streaming keeps the existing parallel metadata/execution reads.

positive_validation.build_summary: 948 Bazel actions; 937 action-cache hits, 8 misses, 2 internal, 9 linux-sandbox; 15.179s elapsed.
positive_validation.execution_id_limit: bbapi execution returned no rows; report one hosted TestRunner attempt, not a unique remote execution ID.

negative_control.setup: Pinned original remotebazel.go at the same source base; full original test file retained; only the added reconciliation test selected by Go test filter.
negative_control.result: Expected regression: one selected case failed at the assertion receiving the original Internal RST_STREAM error; not a compile failure.
negative_control.restoration: All three final candidate files were restored from saved copies and their SHA256 values matched the green tested patch.
negative_control.invalid_setup_note: A separate earlier control setup compile failure removed an existing helper; it ran zero tests and is excluded from negative evidence.

shipping_assessment.current_downstream_path: nix/artifact-pins.json pins bb to the upstream 5.0.500 Linux x86_64 release asset; nix/packages/bb.nix only copies that artifact into $out/bin/bb.
shipping_assessment.standard_release_constraint: devinfra/ci/artifact_targets.json has no bb pin/release target. The release matrix derives assets from declared Bazel targets/BEP outputs, so the existing content-addressed pipeline cannot publish a patched bb binary without adding a real Bazel artifact target.
shipping_assessment.upstream_build_path: The pinned upstream source defines //cli/cmd/bb. Its release-cli workflow builds it with bazelisk --stamp --compilation_mode=opt --strip=always and uploads a versioned Linux asset to the upstream release.
shipping_assessment.source_build_cost: BuildBuddy is a Bzlmod module including apt, Go, Python, OCI, static, toolchain, and web dependency layers; go.mod requires Go 1.27.3. A downstream Bazel target would need to import and lock that module graph. A Nix Go-module build would be a new, unverified packaging path rather than a small pin update.
shipping_assessment.recommendation: Prefer an upstream fix followed by the official BuildBuddy CLI release. Ducktape can then update the upstream URL/hash in nix/artifact-pins.json and package version in nix/packages/bb.nix. This is the smallest supportable route and avoids a second binary owner.
shipping_assessment.bounded_local_probe_if_urgent: In an isolated BuildBuddy source checkout, apply this exact patch at the pinned commit and run the upstream release build command via bbr; verify the produced bb version and hash. Treat that as build feasibility only. Before shipping downstream, decide whether to maintain a source-built Nix derivation or import BuildBuddy as a Bazel dependency plus artifact_targets release target; neither currently exists or has been validated.
shipping_assessment.no_external_action: No upstream issue/message/PR, fork, package pin change, repository wiring, binary release or installation was made. A separate hosted static build succeeded; see binary_build_evidence.
source_references: Ducktape: nix/artifact-pins.json:7-9; nix/packages/bb.nix:6-15; nix/packages/default.nix:516; devinfra/ci/artifact_targets.json has no bb row; .github/actions/release-artifact/action.yml resolves the declared Bazel target output.

limits: Tests use scripted gRPC clients. No live BuildBuddy service reset injection was run.
A static patched CLI was built and inspected separately; it remains uninstalled, unpackaged, unpinned and unreleased.
One passing target attempt and one targeted pre-fix failing attempt establish regression sensitivity, not a reliability rate.
RBE build action/cache counts are not a latency or end-to-end CI saving claim.
